{{Quote|Anyone, anyone, Mayday! This is the ''Third Time Lucky''- we have lost engine control. Our power core is out, life support is fading fast. Someone please help, we are drifting into the flight path!|Pilot of the ''Third Time Lucky''|<ref name="Outward Bound (Living Force adventure)">{{LivingForce|Looking In: Outward Bound}}</ref>}}
'''''Third Time Lucky''''' was a civilian [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that was present in the [[Druckenwell system/Legends|Druckenwell system]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Dessin's Dagger]]'' attempted to flee the [[Star system/Legends|system]], it collided with the ''Third Time Lucky'' and inflicted a lot of damage to it.
